verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a hardware security key, since vendors in this category can ship developer libraries, so the axis applies. The runtime probe states Titan ships no vendor SDK, CLI, API, or MCP surface of its own. The docs cover only end-user setup and FIDO standards compatibility, and standards support is an adjacent building block rather than an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
